title: Battle of Grunwald in 3D
content: A team of digital artists has created a stereoscopic interpretation of the painting "Battle of Grunwald" by Jan Matejko.(Video link) The best way to interpret the depth is with a video turn."The project posed a challenge to animators, who were required to meticulously interpret and recreate the 1878 original and find solutions to problems such as how to depict figures who were partially obscured by those next to them."See a visual breakdown of the project and a longer videoat the project website.
